description_en: Creates a project for a specified enterprise by calling this operation
description_zh: 通过调用本接口，可以向指定企业内新增项目信息
kebab_example: aliyun btripopen project-add --third-part-id project_1234 --project-name '商旅出差项目' --code pro_code_5678 --third-part-invoice-id 400009 --third-part-cost-center-id 1000001 --x-acs-btrip-so-corp-token feth0000wls --has-manager false --api-version 2022-05-20 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ProjectAdd

parameters.help_en:
The invoice title ID associated with this project.
- You can obtain this value by calling the [Query available invoice titles for an enterprise or employee](https://open.alibtrip.com/#/document/server/invoicesearch?handbookId=development-support) operation
parameters.help_zh:
与本项目关联的发票抬头 ID。
- 可通过[查询企业或员工可用发票抬头](https://open.alibtrip.com/#/document/server/invoicesearch?handbookId=development-support)接口获取
parameters.name: third_part_invoice_id

parameters.help_en:
The cost center ID associated with this project.
- You can obtain this value by calling the [Query cost centers](https://open.alibtrip.com/#/document/server/costcenterquery?handbookId=development-support) operation
parameters.help_zh:
与本项目关联的成本中心 ID。
- 可通过[查询成本中心](https://open.alibtrip.com/#/document/server/costcenterquery?handbookId=development-support)接口查询获取
parameters.name: third_part_cost_center_id

parameters.help_en:
The enterprise access token.

- This is a required header parameter for HTTP calls. For information about how to obtain the token, refer to [Enterprise access token](https://openapi.alibtrip.com/doc/toDocDetail?docId=3769985).
- You can use `corp_token=value` in the request URL as an alternative
parameters.help_zh:
企业访问凭证。

- 是 HTTP 调用方式的 header 必填参数之一，获取方式请参见：[企业访问凭证](https://openapi.alibtrip.com/doc/toDocDetail?docId=3769985)。
- 可以在请求地址中使用 `corp_token=value` 替代
parameters.name: x_acs_btrip_so_corp_token

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to set a project manager
parameters.name: has_manager
